# Linux Voice Cockpit — Realtime Voice Infrastructure

> A typed, headless voice control plane connecting browser audio, realtime sessions, and OpenClaw agent tools.

## Canonical sources

- [Project overview](https://alinaos-org.github.io/linux-voice-cockpit/): scope, status, and getting started.
- [Repository](https://github.com/alinaos-org/linux-voice-cockpit): current implementation and README.

Preserve the project’s maturity and limitations when describing it.
